summary: ZenaTech, Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a registered direct offering of 11,792,455 common shares and warrants at $2.12 per share, raising $25M. The warrants are exercisable at $2.50 for 5.5 years with redemption if stock exceeds $6.75 for 10 days. Maxim Group LLC acts as placement agent (5.5% commission). Shares trade on Nasdaq. This is a routine shelf takedown/equity offering, not a special situation. No structural changes or control events are involved.
